title: Tech Note: 4D Blogger and SOAP Part II

historical_commentary.text: 4D Blogger as a demo application and its SOAP-based client/server architecture are long obsolete; modern blogging platforms and client/server integrations use REST/JSON APIs almost universally now, so this note is chiefly of historical interest as a snapshot of early-2000s blogging-meets-Web-Services technology demonstrations.
related_updates: SOAP-based blogging APIs (like the MetaWeblog/Blogger APIs of this era) have been superseded by modern REST/JSON-based content APIs
